//: One entry per screen to compare: storyboard artboard (390x844) vs the real app route rendered with a scenario (preview/scenarios/<scenario>.ts). Edit freely: route, scenario, notes and steps (Playwright actions run before the screenshot: fill/click/press/wait/waitFor/scroll). See preview/README.md.

screens.title: 1.1 Welcome and sign-in
screens.notes: Welcome and sign-in in one screen, (auth)/index (the separate /sign-in screen is gone). Sign in with Apple shows because the preview reports Platform.OS ios to app code. A poster moment: the Skov field with the in-app tagline (decision 8). The Terms line keeps the app's wording ("You accept the Terms before you start": acceptance is the explicit tick in onboarding step 1). Fits 844 px; on a shorter screen the mark's box gives up height (202 to 120) before the page scrolls.

screens.title: 1.2 About you
screens.notes: Step 1 of 6: first name, date of birth and the Terms. Accepted deviation: the storyboard has no Terms tick (its welcome says "By continuing you accept the Terms"); DESIGN §3.1 step 3 keeps an explicit one that starts unticked, as the Terms are a contract: a plain checkbox under the fields with the Terms and privacy notice links. 52 px inputs, the 15/22 Ink 2 lede, Continue (Skov 54). Steps type the storyboard's answers with the preview's viewer name.

screens.title: 1.3 Your area
screens.notes: Step 2 of 6, where completeOnboarding runs. Steps type 8000, then tap the title so the field shows unfocused, as drawn: the white card shows Aarhus C with the outlined cell on the street map. Its status pill comes from the bundled areas.json (packages/core): every launch area is on the waitlist there, so the quiet outline pill "Aarhus opens soon" (clock) where the storyboard has the Ink "Aarhus is live" (check); the area doc is only readable after onboarding. "Where did you hear about Friendpod?" and the GeoNames credit follow under the card (app-only). No back chevron on a direct load (nothing to go back to); coming from step 1 it shows.

screens.title: 1.4 Consent for sensitive interests (once)
screens.notes: Step 3 of 6. Consent copy is hash-locked in packages/core (art9-blanket-*): match the look, not the storyboard wording. The copy scrolls inside its white box with the 1.5 px Ink border (private stays quiet); the box takes the room between the title and the pinned consent box, "I agree" and the quiet "Not now" (the page does not scroll; where that room is under 160 px the copy and the actions flow in one scrolling column instead). No back chevron: completeOnboarding started a fresh stack.

screens.title: 1.5 Interests
screens.notes: Step 4 of 6. Steps type "brætspilsaften" and tap Add; the scenario answers with the suggestion "brætspil" ("Did you mean ...?"), and "brætspilsaften" stays dashed until it is answered. Chips take their pod colour from their word; the words give the storyboard's colours (brætspil Tomat, sourdough Solsikke, far på barsel Fjord), gravid is the quiet private chip. Area chips (Popular in Aarhus) come from areas/aarhus and stay neutral. Continue is pinned: the locked interest notice is longer than the storyboard's note, so the list scrolls above it.

screens.title: 1.6 Who you'd like to meet
screens.notes: Step 5 of 6. Prefs: ages 28–42, 10 km, Danish + English (named in the reader's language, as the Me summary does; the storyboard writes the endonym "Dansk"), weekday evenings + Saturday/Sunday daytime. Selected choices are Ink (the distance with a check), the slider and the switch Skov. The ages hint keeps the app's wording ("Starts around your own age": the alpha profile widens the default to ±13). No back chevron on a direct load (nothing to go back to); coming from step 4 it shows.

screens.title: 1.7 Photo, about me, notifications, pledge
screens.notes: Step 6 of 6: photo (the dashed open-seat disc), About me (typed in the user's language by the scenario), notifications (secondary, bell) and the safety pledge; Finish (the one primary, pinned) stays disabled until the pledge is ticked, then ends onboarding (Home is then the waitlist while the city is not live). The steps tick the pledge so Finish shows enabled (the storyboard draws its pledge box unticked), then scroll back to the title in case the cards scroll above Finish (large text). No back chevron on a direct load (nothing to go back to); coming from step 5 it shows.

screens.title: 1.8 Your city's waitlist (until it opens)
screens.notes: Home tab while the area is not live (WaitlistScreen): Odense, 186 of 250. Calm, not a poster moment (no field, no mark), as the storyboard draws it. The preview's hosting domain is long, so the link shows on two lines. The next-step copy keeps the app's wording (the goal is a target, not a promise). "Profile and settings" sits where the storyboard has its prototype link.

screens.notes: Home tab, Tuesday of week 46 before the drop. Interests include one private ("gravid"), which must not appear in "What we'll match on". One active pod (sourdough, Sat 14:00, bakery café, Frederiksbjerg) and an archived one.

screens.title: 2.2 The drop: a pod proposal
screens.notes: Home tab right after the drop: brætspil proposal, not answered.

screens.title: 2.3 Why this pod
screens.notes: Modal sheet over the home tab. Server reason codes only.

screens.title: 2.4 Waiting for the others
screens.notes: The storyboard is the home tab ("This week" active, "Your weekly drop") after saying yes: 3 of 5, 4 needed. The same state on the pod route is app-pod-waiting.

screens.notes: Home tab, no pod this week, reason NO_THEME_BUCKET (names no setting). The 3-weeks variant that names a setting is app-home-none-setting.

screens.title: 3.1 Pod confirmed
screens.notes: Pod screen right after confirmation, planning, no options yet. Storyboard shows the tab bar with Pods active and a back arrow.

screens.title: 3.2 Plan the meetup
screens.notes: Monday 16 Nov, voting closes Tuesday 17 Nov 18:00 (72 h after the pod was confirmed at Saturday's answer deadline; see WEEK46 in scenarios/_pod.ts). Two options: Sat 21 Nov 14:00 (3 yes: Mette, Jonas, you) and Sun 22 Nov 11:00 (2 yes, you have not voted). One spot left. The storyboard's "Saturday 15 Nov" comes before both deadlines.

screens.title: 3.3 Suggest a time and a public place
screens.notes: "Suggest a time" opens from the planner's "Suggest another time". Steps pick Sunday 22 Nov at 15:00 from the Day and Time sheets (the storyboard's Sunday, after the planning window: see WEEK46 in scenarios/_pod.ts), type "café latin" in the place search, pick the first placeholder place so it shows selected, and focus the search again (the storyboard draws it focused). Place search goes to the scenario's places, named in the preview's language (Google Places is stubbed on the network).

screens.title: 3.4 Pod page: next step, plan, chat, members
screens.notes: Friday 19:30, meetup Saturday 14:00: "Still coming?" pending, chat open (3 messages), Sofie hasn't confirmed.

screens.title: 3.5 Meetup chat (24 h before to 24 h after)
screens.notes: Saturday 13:58, five messages (two from today). Messages expire 72 h after the meetup.

screens.title: 4.1 How did it go? (push the next morning)
screens.notes: Sunday 10:05, the morning after; a calm screen in the pod's colour context (avatars in Tomat deep from the word brætspil, no photos). Steps answer the storyboard's state: Yes to meeting Mette and Jonas again (Sofie and Ahmed left blank), rating 4. "Meet again" is Yes / No per person (DESIGN §3.6, D9: yes, no or no answer; a no is a soft block): two 36 px round choices, the chosen one in Ink like the rating chips and pod-plan's Yes / No. The quiet "I wasn't there myself" check (met: false) sits at the right of the back row, so the page keeps one screen in both languages; the explainer carries the majority no-show rule and "Not sure? Leave it blank". The storyboard was redrawn to this three-state version (it used to draw one checkbox per person, blank meaning no): a deliberate content change awaiting the founder's sign-off.

screens.title: 4.2 Member: block or report
screens.notes: Member sheet for Jonas: a bottom sheet over the scrim, the 72 px avatar in Tomat deep, "In your [brætspil] pod" with the Tomat pod chip, Block and Report as Danger outline buttons with their texts under them. The meetup chat is still open, so the pod counts as active and Block says Jonas is taken out. Report's line keeps the app's wording ("Reports can pause someone from matching"): nobody reads reports (D2), so the storyboard's "A person on our team reviews it" would not be true.

screens.title: 4.3 Report
screens.notes: Report Jonas (user report): the safety alert (white, Danger border, phone icon), reasons as white radio rows, the 1.5 px Field text area, Send report in Skov. Steps pick "I felt unsafe" as on the storyboard. The message-report variant is app-sheets-report-message.

screens.notes: Home tab, week 48: proposal about the private interest "gravid" (no age span, no shared interests by schema).

screens.title: 5.2 Interests and private interests
screens.notes: Interests tab: 4 interests, each with the pod-colour dot of its word (the words map to the storyboard table: brætspil Tomat, sourdough Solsikke, far på barsel Fjord, trail running Blad), and the private "gravid" in the quiet card (consent given 4 Nov 2026), 5 of 20, with "This isn't sensitive for me" (D2) closing the card and "How private interests work" under it.

screens.title: 5.3 Privacy settings
screens.notes: Me → Privacy. 1 private interest with consent, same-gender off, photo shown to confirmed pods, 1 blocked person, no export in progress. Opened directly, so there is no back chevron (on a phone it shows above "Me"). The Datatilsynet complaint line closes the page.

screens.title: 5.4 Delete account
screens.notes: Delete account. Provider is Apple (re-auth before deletion). "Sign in again and delete" asks once more (native alert), then re-authenticates.
